bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
name=deploy-gaybbs-1
if docker inspect "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo BOT_CONTAINER_PRESENT=YES; else echo BOT_CONTAINER_PRESENT=NO; fi
if test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null)" = true; then echo BOT_RUNNING=YES; else echo BOT_RUNNING=NO; fi
live="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null || true)"
candidate="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:gate-link-final-1cae702 2>/dev/null || true)"
if test -n "$live" && test "$live" = "$candidate"; then echo LINK_SOURCE_IMAGE_ACTIVE=YES; else echo LINK_SOURCE_IMAGE_ACTIVE=NO; fi
if docker exec "$name" test -f /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo BOT_BUNDLE_PRESENT=YES; else echo BOT_BUNDLE_PRESENT=NO; fi
if docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -q -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||'|'||COALESCE(message_id::text,'NONE')||'|'||state FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' ORDER BY chat_id" 2>/dev/null; then echo PANEL_READBACK=PASS; else echo PANEL_READBACK=FAIL; fi
echo DIAGNOSTIC_EXIT=0
